title: Boba Fett Dragged Through the Desert
description: After Boba Fett's near-impossible escape from the Sarlacc pit, he was stripped of his armor and equipment by scavenging Jawas. Lying pillaged and unconscious, Fett was found by Tusken Raiders shortly thereafter. Awakened by the nomads, Fett was pulled by a bantha forced to walk across the open desert and through a sandstorm, before finally collapsing. Making no difference to the Tusken Raiders, the bantha dragged Fett the rest of the way.
